inputs.question: Roadmap 将 LLM 与 KG 的融合归纳为哪三类路线？

outputs.expected_answer: 三类路线为 KG-enhanced LLMs、LLM-augmented KGs、Synergized LLMs + KGs。

source_references.answer_point: 三类路线为 KG-enhanced LLMs、LLM-augmented KGs、Synergized LLMs + KGs。
source_references.title: Unifying Large Language Models and Knowledge Graphs: A Roadmap

required_facts.required_fact: 三类路线为 KG-enhanced LLMs、LLM-augmented KGs、Synergized LLMs + KGs。
required_facts.coverage_rule: 本事实的任一已核查支持来源即可；不同必要事实必须全部覆盖。

source_evidence.title: Unifying Large Language Models and Knowledge Graphs: A Roadmap
source_evidence.source_relative_path: Surveys/010_Unifying Large Language Models and Knowledge Graphs A Roadmap.pdf
source_evidence.text:
Abstract—Large language models (LLMs), such as ChatGPT and GPT4, are making new waves in the field of natural language
processing and artificial intelligence, due to their emergent ability and generalizability. However, LLMs are black-box models, which
often fall short of capturing and accessing factual knowledge. In contrast, Knowledge Graphs (KGs), Wikipedia and Huapu for example,
are structured knowledge models that explicitly store rich factual knowledge. KGs can enhance LLMs by providing external knowledge
for inference and interpretability. Meanwhile, KGs are difficult to construct and evolve by nature, which challenges the existing methods
in KGs to generate new facts and represent unseen knowledge. Therefore, it is complementary to unify LLMs and KGs together and
simultaneously leverage their advantages. In this article, we present a forward-looking roadmap for the unification of LLMs and KGs.
Our roadmap consists of three general frameworks, namely, 1) KG-enhanced LLMs, which incorporate KGs during the pre-training and
inference phases of LLMs, or for the purpose of enhancing understanding of the knowledge learned by LLMs; 2) LLM-augmented KGs,
that leverage LLMs for different KG tasks such as embedding, completion, construction, graph-to-text generation, and question
answering; and 3) Synergized LLMs + KGs, in which LLMs and KGs play equal roles and work in a mutually beneficial way to enhance
both LLMs and KGs for bidirectional reasoning driven by both data and knowledge. We review and summarize existing efforts within
these three frameworks in our roadmap and pinpoint their future research directions.

relation_review.evidence: 核对全部必要事实、引用与原文；没有来源时不得补造。
relation_review.semantics: 核对关系方向、实体角色、任务/实验条件和题干前提。
relation_review.uncertainty: 必要证据不足时明确说明缺口；反例允许纠正前提。

scoring_rules.primary: 沿用 SupportRecall@5；事实单元内支持来源 OR，必要事实单元之间 AND。
secondary: MRR@40: reciprocal first rank containing any known supporting unit
scoring_rules.denominator: 32 道可回答题；其中 24 道跨文本题另报；8 反例单列，不计召回总分。
scoring_rules.relevance: 仅原文核查后的有限支持池；没有穷举所有等价来源，池外不等于不相关。
scoring_rules.latency: retrieval compute measured around production methods, excludes audit stage uploads and shared cloud embedding batch; generation separately timed incl provider tracing
scoring_rules.p95: 按各类别及全部可回答题分别计算，单次小样本不表示 SLA。
scoring_rules.answer_review: R01—R24、N01—N08 两组均逐项核对预期答案、全部来源、关系方向/角色与缺口表达；不以引用格式代替语义核查。
scoring_rules.relation_gold: reasoning_chain 为人工可审阅的分析提纲，不是生产图路径金标；共享基准、分析比较不自动对应图谱 Schema 边。
scoring_rules.interpretation: 分别报告基础、跨文本、反例表现；新旧题集分布不同，不能由总分变化推导系统改善或 Graph 胜出。

evaluation_config.planned_output: 仅检索与证据评估（原冻结方案）

controls.query_vectors: one batched cloud call, reused unchanged across paired arms
controls.order: odd numbered case Hybrid first, even Graph first; one warmup; no response retries
controls.generation_policy: 基础 8 题仅检索；24 道关系题与 8 道反例按证据门控生成，最多 64 次配对生成调用。

result_display.location: 本题关联的 Hybrid / Hybrid+Graph Experiment runs
fields: 全部图路径与生成采用路径
result_display.semantic_review: 自动覆盖分数不是答案正确性；语义判读单独标注。

metadata.review_origin: Codex delegated source review; not independent human scoring
metadata.content_scope: 逐题参考事实、原文证据和位置、关系判读、评分与运行配置；实际结果关联 Experiment。
